Ectoplasm
Type: Material
Value: 0
Fine Value: 5
Keywords: Misc.
Processed
Properties:
Bankable:     Droppable:
Sellable:     Tradable:

A refined piece of ghostly energy that looks and feels slimy to the touch. Ghosts value it in this form and it still even has other uses.

The Ectoplasm item is a material.

Variations

This item can be obtained in the following variations. The 'fine' quality material can can be crafted from artisan recipes by using all fine material inputs.
